defs.def: to arrive at the place that you have been travelling to 到达；抵达

ex.s: However, most produce at the store went through weeks of travel and covered hundreds of miles before reaching the table.
ex.t: 然而，商店里的大多数农产品在端上餐桌之前都经过了数周的运输、跨越了数百英里。

ex.s: She stopped thinking about the word “mile.” Instead, she focused on reaching the shadow cast on the track by an oak tree up ahead.
ex.t: 她不再去想“英里”这个词。相反，她专注于到达前方一棵橡树投在跑道上的影子。

ex.s: They reached the shooting spot later than expected.
ex.t: 他们比预期更晚到达拍摄地点。

ex.s: Cao ___67___ (walk) through 34 countries in six continents and in 2016, he reached the top of Kilimanjaro, Africa’s ___68___ (high) mountain.
ex.t: 曹___67___ (walk)徒步走过六大洲34个国家，2016年他登上了非洲最高峰乞力马扎罗山___68___ (high)。

ex.s: As he went on to share his concept with others, the idea soon took off in India and other countries before eventually reaching Europe, where it became popular in places like France, Belgium and the Netherlands.
ex.t: 当他与其他人分享他的概念时，这个想法很快在印度和其他国家流行起来，最终传到欧洲，在法国、比利时和荷兰等地受欢迎。

ex.s: The best of a Kilimanjaro   50  , in my opinion, isn’t reaching the top.
ex.t: 以我的观点来看，乞力马扎罗之旅最美好的部分不是到达山顶。

ex.s: We reached Albuquerque in the late afternoon.
ex.t: 我们在傍晚时分到达了阿尔伯克基。

ex.s: We reached the stream, and they unwillingly walked ahead.
ex.t: 我们到达了小溪，他们不情愿地继续往前走。

ex.s: I climbed and climbed． There was nothing but just green bushes and these steps． I had to reach the top!
ex.t: 我爬呀爬。除了绿色的灌木和这些台阶什么都没有。我必须到达山顶！

ex.s: From the minute reached our house, I started to read. knew this was extreme happiness, knew it at the time.
ex.t: 从到达我们家的那一刻起，我就开始读。我知道这是极度的快乐，当时就知道。

ex.s: Reaching them to get the honey is difficult—and often ____43____ .
ex.t: 到达那里取蜂蜜很困难——而且经常____43____。

ex.s: （2）Why did the author hurry back home without reaching the top of the mountain？ Give two reasons．（no more than 15 words）
ex.t: （2）作者为什么没有到达山顶就匆忙回家？给出两个原因。（不超过15个词）

ex.s: Eventually, it manages to reach the places where it will spend the winter.
ex.t: 最终，它成功到达了将要过冬的地方。

ex.s: We reached Quebec on the eighth day, where most people speak French.
ex.t: 我们在第八天到达了魁北克，那里大多数人讲法语。

ex.s: It was that voice in the back of my head telling me that one phrase that has stopped so many people from reaching their potential: I can’t.
ex.t: 正是我脑海中的那个声音告诉我那个阻止许多人发挥潜力的短语：我不行。

ex.s: Applicants in technical assignments must have reached the last year of their studies in a technical institution．
ex.t: 技术类岗位申请人必须是在技术院校就读最后一年的学生．

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我们都认识那些在到达人生中点之前就耗尽精力的人。

ex.s: Dunn believes that people who reach out to strangers feel a significantly greater sense of belonging, a bond with others.
ex.t: 邓恩认为，主动与陌生人接触的人会感到明显更强的归属感，一种与他人之间的纽带。

defs.def: to come to sb's attention 引起 … 的注意
to increase to a particular level, speed, etc. over a period of time 增加到，提升到（某一水平、速度等）

ex.s: The number of medical schools reached 18 in the early 1990s and ______ around that level since. （    ）
ex.t: 医学院的数量在20世纪90年代初达到了18所，此后一直保持在那个水平左右。（    ）

ex.s: They really do reach out to us across the centuries as if time itself were nothing.
ex.t: 他们确实跨越了几个世纪与我们交流，仿佛时间本身毫无阻隔。

defs.def: to arrive at a particular point or stage of sth after a period of time 达到（某点）；进入（某阶段）

ex.s: He soon reached his first target of $70, but when he gave the money to a charity, he was told that it actually cost $2,000 to build a well.
ex.t: 他很快达到了70美元的第一个目标，但当他将钱交给一个慈善机构时，他被告知建造一口井实际上需要2000美元。

defs.def: to achieve a particular aim 实现；达到

ex.s: A strong-willed soul can reach his goal.
ex.t: 意志坚强的人能够实现自己的目标。

ex.s: reach a conclusion
ex.t: 得出结论。

defs.def: to stretch your hand towards sth in order to touch it, pick it up, etc. 伸；伸手

ex.s: When the cashier rang everything up, my dad reached for his wallet and froze.
ex.t: 当收银员把一切都结账时，我爸爸伸手去拿钱包，却僵住了。

defs.def: to be able to stretch your hand far enough in order to touch sth, pick sth up, etc. 能伸到；够得着

ex.s: They pulled the sausage beyond the dog’s reach.
ex.t: 他们把香肠拉到了狗够不着的地方。

ex.s: keep all her tools within easy reach
ex.t: 把她所有的工具放在随手够得着的地方。

ex.s: Samuel, the tallest boy in our class, ______ easily reach the books on the top shelf.
ex.t: Samuel，我们班最高的男生，______能轻松地够到顶层书架上的书。

ex.s: But at times it seems too difficult and too far out of reach.
ex.t: 但有时它似乎太难，也太过遥不可及（够不着）。

ex.s: Reaching as far as the eye can see, these terraces cover tall mountains, often from the bottom to the very top.
ex.t: 这些梯田一望无际，覆盖着高山，常常从山脚一直延伸到山顶。

defs.def: to stretch your hand out or up in order to get sth for sb 伸手取（物）；传递

ex.s: Emily Sanders, a 25-year-old from Detroit, Michigan, set out on December 23rd with high hopes of reaching Toronto to meet her boyfriend for Christmas.
ex.t: 25岁的Emily Sanders来自密歇根州底特律，12月23日她满怀希望地出发，打算赶到多伦多与男友共度圣诞节。

ex.s: As I read, he reaches out and pokes（戳）the page with his finger.
ex.t: 当我读书时，他伸出手用手指戳（戳）页面。

ex.s: But instead of passing it through the hole to the dog, they would then pull it out of its reach.
ex.t: 但随后他们不会把香肠穿过洞递给狗，而是会把它拉到狗够不着的地方。

defs.def: to be big enough, long enough, etc. to arrive at a particular point （大或长等）足够达到
to communicate with sb, especially by telephone （尤指用电话）联系，与 … 取得联系

ex.s: I wanted to reach businesses too.
ex.t: 我也想联系企业。

ex.s: How can Sabrina reach her sister now?
ex.t: 萨布丽娜现在怎么联系到她的妹妹？

ex.s: But when he finally reached her, the woman flooded him with questions: "Who are you？What antique shop？" However, when she hung up, she regretted the way she had handled the call.
ex.t: 但当他终于联系上她时，这位女士连珠炮似地问了他很多问题："你是谁？哪家古董店？"然而，当她挂断电话后，她后悔自己处理这次通话的方式。

defs.def: to be seen or heard by sb 被 … 看到（或听到）

ex.s: It'll reach consumers soon.
ex.t: 它很快会面向消费者。

defs.def: the distance over which you can stretch your arms to touch sth; the distance over which a particular object can be used to touch sth else 手臂展开的长度；臂展

ex.s: Reaching the end of the hallway, though, Grant____28____a half-open door.
ex.t: 走到走廊尽头时，Grant____28____一扇半开的门。

ex.s: The Transition, which flew at 1,400 feet for eight minutes last month, can reach around 70 miles per hour on the road and 115 in the air.
ex.t: Transition上个月以1400英尺的高度飞行了8分钟，在公路上时速可达70英里左右，在空中可达115英里。

ex.s: The Transition, which flew at 1,400 feet for eight minutes last month, can reach around 70 miles per hour on the road and 115 in the air.
ex.t: Transition上个月以1400英尺的高度飞行了8分钟，在公路上时速可达70英里左右，在空中可达115英里。

ex.s: Without motivation you can neither set a goal nor reach it
ex.t: 没有动力，你既不能设定目标也不能达成目标

defs.def: the limit to which sb/sth has the power or influence to do sth 波及范围；影响范围

ex.s: Yet as the months of reducing waste continued, I did what I could that was within my own reach.
ex.t: 然而随着减少浪费的日子一天天过去，我在力所能及的范围内尽我所能。

ex.s: in the shape of     B. beyond the reach of
ex.t: 以…的形状 B. 超出…的触及范围（即够不着）

defs.def: a straight section of water between two bends on a river 河段；直水道
the parts of an area or a place that are a long way from the centre 边缘地带；边远地区

ex.s: So to try to change a distinctly modern behavior, lawmakers and public health experts are reaching back to an old approach: They want to treat distracted driving like drunk driving.
ex.t: 所以为了试图改变一种典型的现代行为，立法者和公共卫生专家正在回归一种旧方法：他们想把分心驾驶像酒驾一样对待。

defs.def: the higher, etc. sections of an organization, a system, etc. （组织、体制等的）领域，部门
